content_sections.heading: PJTAU Part Time Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PJTAU Part Time Teacher Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University (PJTAU).

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being recruited?
faq.answer: Candidates are being recruited for the post of Part Time Teacher in English.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 temporary vacancy available for the Part Time Teacher position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for PJTAU Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates directly attend the interview at the specified venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 03 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Warangal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A in English along with Ph.D in English, NET, SLET, or 2 years teaching experience at U.G. level.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 1000/- per hour/class, up to a maximum consolidated pay of Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending this walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their bio-data particulars, original educational certificates, and one set of Xerox copies to the interview venue.
